A ray of light hits a plane mirror at an angle of incidence of [A] degrees. What is the angle of reflection in degrees?
templates.explanation: Law of reflection: angle of incidence = angle of reflection = [RESULT] degrees. Both angles are always measured from the normal.

templates.pattern: An object is placed [U] cm in front of a plane mirror. How far behind the mirror does the image appear in cm?
templates.explanation: In a plane mirror the image appears as far behind the mirror as the object is in front. Image distance = [RESULT] cm.

templates.pattern: A glass block has a refractive index of [N]. Light travels at 3 × 10⁸ m/s in a vacuum. What is the speed of light inside the glass block in m/s?
templates.explanation: Speed in medium = c ÷ n = 3×10⁸ ÷ [N] = [RESULT] m/s

templates.pattern: A concave mirror has a focal length of [F] cm. What is its radius of curvature in cm?
templates.explanation: Radius of curvature = 2 × focal length = 2 × [F] = [RESULT] cm

templates.pattern: A concave mirror has a radius of curvature of [R] cm. What is its focal length in cm?
templates.explanation: Focal length = radius of curvature ÷ 2 = [R] ÷ 2 = [RESULT] cm

templates.pattern: A ray of light hits a surface at [A] degrees measured from the surface itself. What is the angle of incidence measured from the normal in degrees?
templates.explanation: Angles in optics are always measured from the normal. Angle from normal = 90° − angle from surface = 90 − [A] = [RESULT] degrees.

templates.pattern: A converging lens has a focal length of [F] cm. An object is placed [U] cm from the lens. What is the image distance in cm?
templates.explanation: Lens formula: v = uF ÷ (u − F) = [U] × [F] ÷ ([U] − [F]) = [U*F] ÷ [U-F] = [RESULT] cm

templates.pattern: An image is formed [V] cm from a lens and the object is [U] cm from the lens. What is the magnification?
An object is [H] cm tall. A lens produces a magnification of [M]. What is the height of the image in cm?
templates.explanation: Image height = object height × magnification = [H] × [M] = [RESULT] cm
